claims.claim: The paper states that long-horizon LLM inference makes the KV cache the dominant GPU memory consumer and makes per-token attention increasingly expensive.
claims.quote: Long-horizon LLM inference turns the key--value (KV) cache into the dominant GPU memory consumer and makes per-token attention increasingly expensive.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: CONF-KV keeps memory footprint near a fixed 512-token sliding window while staying within 1.5--2.1 perplexity points of full KV across four model families and generated lengths up to 4K.
claims.quote: Across four model families and generated lengths up to 4K, CONF-KV stays near the footprint of a fixed 512-token sliding window while remaining within 1.5--2.1 perplexity points of full KV.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: On Needle-in-a-Haystack up to 32K tokens, CONF-KV reaches 91.4% retrieval accuracy versus 53.8% for sliding windows and 80.6% for H2O; on 75 VisualWebArena tasks it retains 95.3% of full-KV success at 2.8 times lower peak memory.
claims.quote: On Needle-in-a-Haystack up to 32K tokens, CONF-KV reaches 91.4% retrieval accuracy versus 53.8% for sliding windows and 80.6% for H2O; on 75 VisualWebArena tasks it retains 95.3% of full-KV success at 2.8 times lower peak memory.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: CONF-KV combines blockwise online-softmax attention, mixed FP16/INT8 storage, and a pyramidal per-layer budget variant.
claims.quote: We combine the policy with blockwise online-softmax attention, mixed FP16/INT8 storage, and a pyramidal per-layer budget variant.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: CONF-KV uses the next-token distribution as a scalar confidence score to choose the per-step cache budget, retaining more context when the model is uncertain and pruning aggressively when confident.
claims.quote: We introduce CONF-KV, a KV-cache manager that converts the next-token distribution into a scalar confidence score and uses it to choose the per-step cache budget, retaining more context when the model is uncertain and pruning aggressively when it is confident.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: Within each budget, tokens are ranked by accumulated attention mass and recency, with a protected recent window preserving local coherence.
claims.quote: Within each budget, tokens are ranked by a composite of accumulated attention mass and recency, while a protected recent window preserves local coherence.
